events.title: Bear on Fish Creek, Hyder
events.thought: Fish Creek delivers — a bear with a salmon in its mouth, ten feet away.
events.photoCaption: A black bear works a salmon in Fish Creek near Hyder, AK — the salmon run was on.

events.title: Glacial Bar Camp, BC
events.thought: Camped on the glacial bar with fog threading the mountains — this is Waldo in its element.
events.photoCaption: Waldo set up on a glacial gravel bar in BC, milky turquoise river in front and fog-wrapped mountains behind.
